findings.detail: The stored NAV per share is 1000.0, but the filing reports December 31, 2025 NAV per share of 25.22 for all share classes.

rationale: F30 flags NAV per share outside 0.01 to 1000. The source financial statement table reports net asset value per share of $25.22 at December 31, 2025, corroborated by the monthly NAV table showing $25.22 for all classes on December 31, 2025. The extracted observed value of 1000.0 is not supported by the source.
